habitats.status: 32-person lightweight two-deck concept: two 8.5 m-floor discs at 0.25 g, filled to the hub; hardware targets, torpor and full-diet food factory unvalidated
habitats.preferred_arrival_architecture: Staged surface delivery: habitats and settlement equipment descend; cruise-only module remains in orbit.
habitats.landing_propulsion_selection: Hybrid candidate: direct antimatter orbital braking, then antimatter-heated hydrogen terminal descent; safe cutoff unresolved
habitats.landing_acceleration_policy: Size for braking needs subject to crew, structural and equipment limits; no 1.2g landing cap

geometry_study_not_selected_dimensions.interior_room_dimensions: Two decks per disc. Outer deck: four 4-berth bays and four two-cell shared rooms. Inner deck, up to the hub: four three-cell plant, garden, workshop and store rooms. About 375 m2 gross per disc.

operating_states: Expanded, locked habitat during powered flight with floors re-set across the thrust
Expanded, nonrotating surface settlement lying flat round a central hall, joined to two inflatable residences
not_yet_estimated: Validated fabric packing and deployment mechanisms
Pressure, creep, puncture, fire and structural qualification
Refuge endurance, medical recovery and crash-load certification
Access and floor conversion under thrust gravity

common_space_programme.normal_awake_shipwide: Exactly eight people in awake phase, with paired starts staggered every 42 hours; sleep and recovery watchkeeping still require qualification.
common_space_programme.flight_occupancy_policy: Eight awake and 24 torpid during departure, coast and arrival braking. All 32 awake for descent; retain 32 protected descent places. Transit common rooms are sized for eight, surface expansion supports 32.
common_space_programme.quiet_loud_separation: Berth bays alternate with shared rooms on the outer deck; plant, garden, workshop and stores fill the low-gravity inner deck.
common_space_programme.circulation: Each deck is a ring of four merged rooms (outer deck: four two-cell rooms between four berth bays). Rooms are walked through via doorways in bulkheads along a 1.2 m aisle; each shared room has a ladder to the deck above (inner deck to the hub). Egress and disability access require full human-factors review.
common_space_programme.lighting: Indirect circadian lighting, glare-controlled task lights and dimmable cabin lights
common_space_programme.privacy: Curtained two-tier berths in transit; private couple cabins are in the surface inflatables.
common_space_programme.air_quality: Dedicated ventilation diffusers, return grilles and washable surfaces; no crop CO2 enrichment in living areas

habitats.habitat_layout_revision: ISS-informed functional equipment and long-duration social-space proposal; not an as-built replica or certified pressure vessel

settlement.status: Mission design with explicitly assumed advanced fabrication and sufficient local resources

environment.airless_status: Superseded: a thin, dusty atmosphere is now assumed for surface operations and the settlement view. Not an observation; the atmosphere of Proxima b is unknown.
environment.surface_composition_and_accessible_volat: Observationally unknown; sufficient accessible local resources assumed for this design
environment.descent_model_atmosphere: The descent and landing mass model still ignores the atmosphere (no aerobraking credit). That is conservative for propellant; entry heating, winds and dust are not yet assessed.
environment.surface_character: Assumed Mars-like: wind-worked regolith, dunes, scattered rock and few surviving small craters.

power.working_load_status: Provisional allocations, not measured subsystem demand or a selected generator rating
power.peak_load_and_backup_duration: Not yet sized; schedule batch processing and evaluate critical-load shedding

priorities: Habitat and crop heating only when needed

power.cruise_load_status: 2 MWe allocation, not measured demand; no large staple-crop lighting or crop-pod climate plant carried.

greenhouse.construction: Surface greenhouses manufactured locally after food-factory commissioning; not part of carried farm hardware.
greenhouse.primary_growing_medium: Processed local regolith with added/recycled nutrients, water, organics and biological inputs as needed
greenhouse.stacking_status: Four tiers use dwarf/compact crop varieties; a full varied diet at this geometry is a design target, not proven output.
greenhouse.CO2_status: Crop-specific enrichment in an oxygen-containing atmosphere; no universal yield gain or crew-space setpoint assumed
greenhouse.qualified_food_output: Unknown; requires crop mix, lighting, nutrients, yield, failures and population model
greenhouse.light_and_thermal_design: Artificial LED lighting is primary; full air circulation, dehumidification, heat rejection and pressure support; daylight is optional and not credited in lighting budget
greenhouse.surface_view_phase: Later expansion built with local materials, not immediate landing inventory.

manufacturing.goal: Total independence from Earth resupply, accepted as an advanced-technology design assumption
supporting_capabilities: Repair and reproduction of manufacturing equipment
manufacturing.local_raw_material_sufficiency: Assumed sufficient and accessible for all required production and repair
manufacturing.note: Industrial production equipment is a declared separate settlement system, not hidden in the sub-500 kg remote exploration allowance

population.birth_timing_status: Planning target, not guaranteed conception, gestation or healthy birth

cruise_agriculture.reserve_policy: Two years full-crew cruise contingency plus six months surface commissioning; no torpor metabolic discount.
cruise_agriculture.gravity_policy: Capillary root-zone, forced ventilation and robot access needed through coast and thrust; complete-diet yields and long-duration closure unvalidated.
cruise_agriculture.surface_reuse: Same eight pressure bays and growth hardware land, then redeploy with local-regolith-compatible trays and locally made foundations.
cruise_agriculture.status: Historical large crop-farm option, no longer carried in the selected minimum-mass design.

production_chain: Recover CO2, water and waste nutrients

proxima_b_sky.alpha_cen_note: From Proxima b, A and B appear as a close bright pair near magnitudes -6.6 and -5.3.

exploration.status: Planning allocations, not validated vehicle mass estimates or propulsion feasibility

interstellar_relay_chain.status: Proposed design-to requirement; independent power, optical deployment, pointing and antimatter hardware feasibility unclosed
interstellar_relay_chain.receiver: Deployable very thin diffractive/reflective optical membrane focusing a narrowband signal onto a detector; support, focusing and pointing hardware required
interstellar_relay_chain.braking: Each node brakes independently after deployment using assumed 0.5c effective exhaust; fuel, containment, power, cooling and stationkeeping must fit its allocation
interstellar_relay_chain.stationary_definition: Approximately at rest in a chosen Solar-System-barycentric frame after braking, not fixed relative to Earth's orbit; transverse motion and stationkeeping unsolved
interstellar_relay_chain.deployment: Release before desired final location to allow braking; endpoint/acceleration-phase deployment trajectories remain to be solved
interstellar_relay_chain.storage: Compact deployment canister mounted directly to the flight superstructure; expanded receivers deploy after release
interstellar_relay_chain.mass_accounting: 100 kg cap includes matter/antimatter braking fuel, dry hardware, dispenser and development allowance; see mission-300-trade.json
interstellar_relay_chain.communications_role: Low-rate regenerative store-and-forward interstellar optical relay; no credit for replacing ship navigation, control, local radios or an independent survival link

assumptions.torpor_metabolic_discount_status: 300 t trade assumption only: 1500 versus 2500 kcal/person/day. Requires measured physiology; reference hardware budget receives no automatic mass credit.

flight_occupancy.policy: 24 remain in torpor through departure, coast and arrival braking; all 32 are awake for descent. Surface food provision supports 32 awake.

assumptions.design_to_margin_status: 15% planning case requested for comparison; legacy reference remains 25%. Lower allowance accepts more risk, not a physical hardware saving.
assumptions.dry_mass_cap_status: Design-to allocation in mission-300-trade.json; not a validated achieved hardware mass or the existing viewer geometry.
assumptions.food_factory_policy: Two independent complete-diet production trains, protected culture/enzyme banks and common waste recovery. Lowest studied 10 t hardware target, not a demonstrated minimum.
assumptions.thermal_switch_status: Conditional continuous-braking target only. Direct exhaust down to 1 km is not radiation/plume qualified; 0.400 km/s includes 0.0757 km/s beyond ideal terminal thrust integral, not a demonstrated contingency margin.
assumptions.surface_delivery_policy: Retain settlement essentials and mandatory descent equipment. Detach flight-only hardware in a controlled destination orbit before direct terminal descent; trajectory/disposal and staging qualification unresolved.
assumptions.arrival_delta_v_allocation_status: 12 km/s total direct allowance split into 2 km/s before orbital separation and 10 km/s for independent descent. Conditional allocation, not a solved capture/entry trajectory.
assumptions.food_production: Complete-diet microbial/chemical factory, small fresh-food garden; rigid factory must operate during burns and coast.
assumptions.storage_loss_credit: Zero antimatter losses and zero hydrogen boiloff assumed; containment and cooling unproven.
assumptions.engine_exhaust_definition: Thrust divided by total rest-mass loss rate including escaping radiation and particles; optimistic whole-engine 0.5c target.
assumptions.departure_boundary: Assembled in space; Earth launch, fuel production and assembly propellant excluded.
assumptions.arrival_status: 12 km/s total direct allowance split into 2 km/s before orbital separation and 10 km/s for independent descent. Conditional allocation, not a solved capture/entry trajectory.

habitat.status: Same construction coefficients as the three-deck reference. Flat faces need internal ties; a quarter of Earth gravity at about 5 rpm is unvalidated for 20 years.

surface_inflatables.status: Closed pressure vessels, so no ground anchoring against pressure. No orbital debris layer: surface use only. Seam life, deployment at 1.2 g and local weather are unqualified.

engine.status: 0.5c effective exhaust needs about 86% of the charged-pion momentum collimated and is at the ceiling of the beamed-core concept. Thermal closure at 1.2 g relies on the 1e-7 absorbed-fraction assumption, which no physical nozzle geometry here supports.

shadow_shield.status: Sized for dose only. The disc intercepts terawatts and cannot be cooled at 1.2 g; neutrons, muons, scatter round the edge and the true source size are not modelled.

storage.status: Only neutral condensed antihydrogen reaches the required density. Charged levitation, charge retention on the ice, 1.5 K walls and failure containment are undemonstrated; the 38 t containment figure is an allocation.

checks.basis: Euler cantilever, 250 m; the first 0.7 m-radius, 1.5 kg/m mast would buckle above 0.056 g.

checks.load: 1.43 MN in the burns; 5.02 MN in descent braking
checks.basis: Sized by buckling for descent thrust; the interstellar burn uses a fraction of it.
29.9 t per disc on four 240 mm carbon tubes; hub bearing not credited.
16 kg/m2 smeared over the envelope; limit set where inertial load reaches 10% of cabin pressure.

checks.load: 7.3 kN m root moment per rib
checks.basis: Four ribs with 6 cm2 carbon caps 0.5 m apart.
Assumed 10 MV/m charge-retention limit on the ice; an assumption, not a measurement. No safety factor applied.

checks.load: 3.2 kPa head on a 150 kPa shell
checks.basis: Limit where head reaches 20% of design pressure.

structure.status: Static screening of axial load paths only. Dynamics, thrust offset, slosh, joints and thermal distortion are not modelled.

unscreened.note: Solid front shield at the ship: every stopped proton is a thick-target gamma source. A 50 kg/m2 plate attenuates 4.4 MeV photons by only about 15%.

interstellar_flow.status: Thick-target yield is an order-of-magnitude estimate (factor of about two); neutrons, helium and heavier ions add to it. Film survival, hole statistics and charge-state fractions are assumptions.

dedicated_shelter_option.expected_reduction: roughly a quarter to a third; still far above the limit

cosmic_rays.status: Outside the heliosphere the low-energy flux is higher than this measurement. No passive mass this ship can carry meets a 600 mSv career limit over 20 years; this is an open mission-level item.

open_items: Engine heat: the nozzle coil alone intercepts about 12 TW of gamma rays against 0.09 GW assumed absorbed, a gap of about 1e+05.
Shadow shield heat: 2.6 TW intercepted against 7 MW radiated at 3,000 K.
Cosmic rays: about 13 Sv over 20 years against a 0.6 Sv career limit.
Antimatter storage: no demonstrated way to make, charge, levitate or safely fail hundreds of tonnes of antihydrogen ice.

viewer_design.status: Selected viewer design. Screening calculations only: antimatter production, storage, the engine, torpor and radiation protection are not demonstrated, and three items do not close (see open_items).

landing_options.status: Conditional vertical terminal options. Switch height is not radiation/plume approved. Flight-only hardware remains in orbit in every case. No integrated orbital/terrain approach.
landing_options.mass_definition: Final retained mass is after touchdown. Mass at hydrogen ignition also includes hydrogen and its heater reactants.

terminal_model.status: Continuous terminal braking example; no safe direct-exhaust cutoff established

mission_config.torpor_metabolic_discount_status: 300 t trade assumption only: 1500 versus 2500 kcal/person/day. Requires measured physiology; reference hardware budget receives no automatic mass credit.

flight_occupancy.policy: 24 remain in torpor through departure, coast and arrival braking; all 32 are awake for descent. Surface food provision supports 32 awake.

mission_config.design_to_margin_status: 15% planning case requested for comparison; legacy reference remains 25%. Lower allowance accepts more risk, not a physical hardware saving.
mission_config.dry_mass_cap_status: Design-to allocation in mission-300-trade.json; not a validated achieved hardware mass or the existing viewer geometry.
mission_config.food_factory_policy: Two independent complete-diet production trains, protected culture/enzyme banks and common waste recovery. Lowest studied 10 t hardware target, not a demonstrated minimum.
mission_config.thermal_switch_status: Conditional continuous-braking target only. Direct exhaust down to 1 km is not radiation/plume qualified; 0.400 km/s includes 0.0757 km/s beyond ideal terminal thrust integral, not a demonstrated contingency margin.
mission_config.surface_delivery_policy: Retain settlement essentials and mandatory descent equipment. Detach flight-only hardware in a controlled destination orbit before direct terminal descent; trajectory/disposal and staging qualification unresolved.
mission_config.arrival_delta_v_allocation_status: 12 km/s total direct allowance split into 2 km/s before orbital separation and 10 km/s for independent descent. Conditional allocation, not a solved capture/entry trajectory.

design_to_mass_target.status: 300 t cap allocation, not a demonstrated feasible 300 t spacecraft.

occupancy.policy: 24 remain in torpor through departure, coast and arrival braking; all 32 are awake for descent. Surface food provision supports 32 awake.

food.water_note: Process-liquid volume screen only: feedstock/cell displacement, auxiliary stages and hold-up require validation. 100% recovery; no loss reserve.
food.status: Two coast-duty trains; both operate on surface. Complete diet, sustained rate, enzyme renewal and 20-year closure unvalidated.

relay_chain.status: Proposed 100 kg requirement, NOT feasible hardware demonstrated. Wide diffractive receivers included. Independent power, braking/containment, pointing, background rejection and trajectory deployment do not yet close.
relay_chain.stationary_definition: Approximately at rest in a chosen Solar-System-barycentric frame after braking. Gravitational motion, transverse motion and stationkeeping remain to be solved; not Earth-fixed.

thermal.convention: Area counts emitting faces. Specific masses cover panel/heat-pipe/coolant/deployment allocation; primary source areal conventions must be reconciled. No bare-panel figure treated as complete installed hardware.
thermal.status: Loads and installed specific masses are targets. Cold cryogenic lifts, planetary view factors and engine/shield heat remain unclosed.
